page.title: API tokens
page.description: Personal access tokens let tools such as MCP clients act on your behalf. Each token works until it expires or you revoke it.

limit: You can have up to {max} active tokens.

form.name: Name
form.expiresInDaysHint: Between 1 and 365 days. The default is 90.

secret.description: This is the only time the full token is shown. Store it somewhere safe: it cannot be recovered later.
